definitions.source_lines: Positive sale lines with units still active at the exclusive training cutoff. Fully offset lines are absent.
definitions.units: Original sale units less quantities allocated to cancellation proxies observed before the cutoff. Return proxies preserve purchase units.
definitions.recorded_amount_gbp: Surviving units multiplied by the original sale line price, summed over active training purchases.
definitions.repeat_event_share: Basket-item events with an earlier completed basket for the same customer and SKU / all training basket-item events. Equal timestamps provide no earlier history.
definitions.repeated_pair_share: Observed customer-SKU pairs with a strictly later purchase / all observed training customer-SKU pairs.
definitions.interaction_sparsity: 1 - observed distinct customer-SKU pairs / (active customers x observed SKUs).
definitions.head_items: Ceiling of 10% of observed SKUs, ranked by distinct customers descending, then exact StockCode ascending.
definitions.head_event_share: Events for head SKUs / all training events.
definitions.head_customer_reach_share: Distinct customers with any head SKU / distinct active training customers.
